prompt: Roadmap III, Prompt 257 Part A follow-up (the authentic legs): runs the committed legs O1 to O3, F1 to F5 and P2 of tests/fixtures/bao/thresholds.json now that Carl's session has fetched the two sources (the BOSS DR12 consensus BAO-only table and covariance, arXiv:1607.03155 and its data release; Eisenstein and Hu 1998, arXiv:astro-ph/9709112), and adds NEW legs, each with its bound committed here by a stated rule before any validator run, as the delegate's rulings of 2026-11-07 allow (DECISIONS_2026-11-07.md). Documentation and fixtures only; the prototype, the second oracle and the validator live on spike/bao-authentic and are never merged (7.5 rule 4).

parent.note: the parent file, its results.json, its oracle-results.json and its failed-legs.json are NOT touched by this follow-up: their record test pins their hashes. This file only adds.

committed: after tests/fixtures/bao/authentic/ (commit 004d8844: the fixtures and SOURCES.json, which are data and carry no result) and before any second-oracle script, prototype addition, validator run, output or computed quantity of this follow-up existed. No published number, coefficient, covariance value or printed fact was typed from memory: every one is read by script from a fixture (tools/bao-extract-eh98.mjs, tools/bao-extract-alam.mjs on the spike branch, and the byte-for-byte consensus files).
rule: The parent's rule stands word for word: a crossed bound is a failed leg, recorded in a failed-legs file and left failing; only Carl resets one; a leg that cannot be measured because a file or source was not supplied is NOT RUN with an exact request; a threshold that proves unmeasurable fails the gate on that threshold; nothing is moved, re-read or re-defined after a result. Amendments here are recorded before any run and move no committed bound. A NEW leg carries a bound set by the stated rule next to it. New legs never lift or lower the verdict of the parent's function (section verdict); a failing new leg is recorded and left failing like any other.
seenBeforeCommitting: BAO_GATE.md, thresholds.json, results.json and failed-legs.json of the parent, DECISIONS_2026-11-07.md, and the roadmap's Prompt 257 section.

Every fixture of tests/fixtures/bao/authentic/ as written by script: the six consensus values and the 6 x 6 covariance, the printed Table 7 rounding, the printed Table 10 rows (0.317 (9) for Planck, 0.309 (6) for Planck + BAO), r_d,fid 147.78 Mpc, the fiducial Omega_m 0.31, h 0.676, Omega_b h^2 0.022, the paper's pointer for the fiducial's neutrino sector, and the Eisenstein and Hu equations (2) to (6), (26) with their stated accuracy (about 2 percent), stated range and the absence of a stated accuracy for equations (4) and (6).
The rendered PDF pages 4, 5 and 12 of Eisenstein and Hu and page 28 of Alam et al., looked at to check the transcription.

Two hand estimates made while reading, both by mental arithmetic from the printed equations and neither used to set a bound: (a) equation (26) at the Planck best-fit densities gives about 150.0 Mpc, which is 1.99 percent above the printed r_drag 147.049, so F3 was foreseeable to be a narrow pass against the source's own 2 percent; (b) the constant 31.5 of equation (5) equals 3 / (4 omega_gamma) for T = 2.7 K, which is why the equations carry Theta_2.7 = T/2.7 and the integral of F2, F5 and F6 is run at the paper's T = 2.728 K.

The parent's results: E5 failed at 0.288 (prototype) and 0.314 (oracle), P1b's r_L 147.0590, r_H 152.2345, u 0.0309 and the printed 147.049 below r_L by 0.0100. The E6 and P1c bounds below do not use these numbers as targets: E6's is the closed-form prediction at the committed misfit, P1c's is the P1b rule's u with a physically modelled neutrino, and P1c is therefore NOT blind.

By hand, the quadrature range of the O1b diagonal check for the z = 0.38 entries (24.0 to 25.3 for D_M against the file's 25.0; 2.35 to 2.48 for H against the file's 2.37), which passes by the arithmetic of the printed digits.
No sound horizon, distance, chi-square, interval, formula value or ratio of this follow-up was computed by any program before this file was committed.

inputs.note: the legs read only these files, the parent thresholds, and (the prototype) the 255 kernel; the second oracle reads only these files and numpy, scipy and astropy.constants (no astropy.cosmology)

constants.note: G is the CODATA 2018 value that astropy 6.0.1 prints and the parent oracle pinned; 2.7255 K is the parent oracle's pinned Tcmb0; 2.728 K and three massless species are the Eisenstein and Hu paper's own stated assumptions (pdf page 4). k, hbar, c, the Mpc and rho_gamma are as in the parent (soundHorizon.radiation).

paperModel.what: the model of the Eisenstein and Hu formulas, used by the integral wherever a leg compares the formulas with the integral (F2, F5, F6)
paperModel.definition: flat, w = -1, H0 = 100 (h = 1), Om = omega0, Ode = 1 - Om - Or, Or = omega_gamma (1 + (7/8)(4/11)^(4/3) 3) with omega_gamma from T = 2.728 K, omega_b = the node's, z_d = the drag redshift of the paper's equation (4) at the node, Theta_2.7 = 2.728/2.7. At z_d the cosmological constant and curvature are below 1 part in 1e8 of the integrand, so the integral depends only on omega0 and omega_b (stated; h = 1 is the choice that keeps Ob < Om for omega0 up to 0.5).
paperModel.neutrinos: three massless species exactly as the paper states; the integral is run with the same, so the 'bracketed neutrino difference where the formula models neutrinos' of the committed F2 bound is ZERO by construction. The neutrino bracket belongs only to comparisons with a Boltzmann-code number that includes a massive species (P1b, P1c).

formulaIdentification.zd: equation (4) of Eisenstein and Hu (pdf page 5), with Omega0 h^2 = omega_b + omega_c as the paper defines Omega0 (pdf page 4), no neutrino mass
formulaIdentification.rd: equation (26) (pdf page 12): the only formula of the paper for the sound horizon as a function of Omega0 h^2 and Omega_b h^2 alone, and the only one for which the paper states an accuracy and a range. It is 'the cited r_d fitting formula' of the committed legs F2, F3 and F5.
formulaIdentification.eq6: equation (6) with (2), (3) and (5) is the paper's analytic sound horizon (pdf pages 4 and 5); it has no stated accuracy and is tested by the NEW leg F6, not by the committed ones

statedByTheSource.accuracyOfEq26: about 2 percent (the paper's wording is 'to ~2%'; the bound is the number 0.02 exactly, no allowance for the tilde)
statedByTheSource.domainOfEq26: omega_b >= 0.0125 (the paper's lower limit, 'Omega_b h^2 greater than about 0.0125'), 0.025 <= omega0 <= 0.5
statedByTheSource.upperOmegaB: the only upper limit the paper prints for omega_b is 0.03, in the sentence on equation (4) ('For Omega_b h^2 below about 0.03 this epoch follows last scattering'); it is taken as the upper edge of the domain of the pair of formulas, a reading recorded here before any run

formulaGrid.rule: omega0 at 6 geometric nodes from 0.025 to 0.5 inclusive (omega0_k = 0.025 x 20^(k/5), k = 0..5) times omega_b at 4 linear nodes from 0.0125 to 0.03 inclusive, keeping only nodes with omega_b < omega0 (the integral's own domain, Ob < Om at h = 1): 23 nodes (the corner omega0 = 0.025, omega_b = 0.03 is dropped).

outsidePoints.rule: twelve points, three beyond each edge of the stated domain at factors 0.99, 0.5, 0.1 below a lower edge and 1.01, 2, 10 above an upper edge, the other coordinate at 0.14 (omega0) or 0.0224 (omega_b): omega0 in {0.02475, 0.0125, 0.0025} and {0.505, 1.0, 5.0} with omega_b 0.0224; omega_b in {0.012375, 0.00625, 0.00125} and {0.0303, 0.06, 0.3} with omega0 0.14. Codes in the committed order of checking: omega0-below-domain, omega0-above-domain, omegab-below-domain, omegab-above-domain, not-finite. Three inside points that must be ACCEPTED: (0.025, 0.0125), (0.5, 0.03) (both corners of the domain, edges inclusive) and (0.14, 0.0224).

conventions.planckRow: the best-fit column of Table 1 and the fifth column of Table 2 of arXiv:1807.06209 as read by tests/fixtures/bao/authentic/planck-table1.json: omegaB 0.022383, omegaC 0.12011, H0 67.32, r_drag 147.049, z_drag 1059.94 +- 0.30, one neutrino of 0.06 eV

agreement.note: between the prototype and the second oracle; 1e-9 is the parent's soundHorizonVsQuad, 1e-9 and 1e-8 its chi2 and interval tolerances, 1e-12 for a closed-form evaluation in double precision (an elementary function difference between node and numpy is at most a few ulp)

amendments.what: Instantiation of the committed legs F1 to F5 and P2, whose bounds name 'the source's stated accuracy', 'the stated domain' and 'the formula's domain grid' without numbers: the source of F1 is Eisenstein and Hu 1998; its drag-redshift fit is equation (4); its sound-horizon fit with a stated accuracy and range is equation (26); the stated accuracy is 2 percent (equation 26 only), the stated domain and the grids and the twelve outside points are the rules of conventions. The committed bounds of F1 and P2 are 'within the source's stated accuracy plus the printed digits': for equation (4) that threshold proves UNMEASURABLE, and the committed rule ('a threshold that proves unmeasurable fails the gate on that threshold') makes F1 and P2 FAIL. The F3 and F5 bounds use equation (26), whose accuracy IS stated.
